name: B42.21 native video recording fixture
purpose: Validate two short silent in-game captures in a fresh disposable profile; preparation does not launch the game.

dependencies.java: JDK 25 for compilation; game-bundled Java executable for launch
dependencies.ffmpeg: Absolute executable path; build must include libx264

parameters.profile: Must be a new, nonexistent absolute disposable directory

capture.mode: Game framebuffer including UI; no desktop windows

known_observations: A sandbox launch without a usable macOS GUI session stalled at Cocoa Connection Invalid.
A requested 1280x720 window yielded a measured 1728x1020 framebuffer; capture uses measured GLFW pixels.
Synchronous GL readback can reduce game frame rate.
Resize fails the capture and finalizes frames already captured; FFmpeg has a 15-second timeout.
coverage.intake_validation: No new game run during transfer; no-game preparation/metadata tests, Java compilation and retained-clip verification only

artifacts_policy: Contribution contains fixture source and metadata only: no binaries, profiles, logs, videos, secrets, or user-specific absolute paths.
